title: sdr-daily-scratchpad-ava-hamilton-2026-03-08
content:
Morning scratchpad - quick hits + call plan (Thu 2026-03-08)

Daily goals:
- 25 dials, 6 meaningful conversations, 3 demos scheduled
- Clear top-of-funnel prospects that fit mid-market: security/compliance, infra/platform, vertical SaaS
- Move 4 leads from MQL -> SQL (get decision-maker intro)

Priority list (top to work now):
1) OptiSecure (security SaaS) - follow-up 11am PT (left voicemail yesterday) - target: AE intro + qualification call. Notes: CTO is Samir Patel, mentioned wanting private deployment for SOC2 logs. Bring up Dedicated vs Private tradeoffs. Prep: send 1-pager on private deployment + short ROI bullets.
2) NovaInfra (platform infra) - warm inbound via case study download. Task: send calendar invite for 15/20 min discovery, propose Tue/Wed next week. Key: ask about throughput needs (tokens/sec) and burst patterns.
3) RetailPro (vertical SaaS) - email follow-up and add pricing comps. They asked about latency SLOs for peak holiday traffic.
4) AtlasHealth (healthcare) - compliance question, need to loop in security for KMS/HSM specifics. Flag for solutions-engineering.

Call list (order):
- 09:15 - OptiSecure (Samir Patel) - leave short VM, follow with single CTA email for 11am slot.
- 09:45 - Cold cadence call: PotentiaAnalytics - try to uncover owner of LLM initiative.
- 10:20 - NovaInfra (initial discovery) - confirm pain: inconsistent latency across regions.
- 11:00 - Internal sync w/ Jordan - handoff notes for AtlasHealth security questions.
- 13:30 - RetailPro follow-up w/ Emily (buyer) - pricing chat.
- 15:00 - Demo prep call w/ Maya (internal) for slot materials + API quickstart

Scripting snippets (short)
- VM script: "Hi Samir, this is Ava from Redwood Inference - wanted to follow up on your interest in private deployments for SOC2. I'll send a quick email with a few times to chat - appreciate a 10-15 minute window to understand your constraints. Thanks!"
- Email follow-up template (short): "Samir - following up on your interest in private deployment and SOC2 controls. Quick 15-min chat to align on compliance needs and share a short ROI snapshot? [suggest two times]. If not the right person, can you point me to who owns infra/security? Cheers, Ava"

Pipeline notes (quick bullets):
- OptiSecure: Demo-ready if we confirm compliance fit. LTV estimate: $120k ARR. Champion: Samir (CTO).
- NovaInfra: High intent - download + product questions. Could convert to Dedicated pilot. Next step: discovery call.
- RetailPro: Pricing sensitive. Needs quantifiable latency guarantees. Consider proposing burst pool + fallback to cheaper model.
- AtlasHealth: Regulated; need Private deployment + audit logs. Escalate to solutions-eng for compliance docs.

Blocked / help needed:
- Need KMS/HSM integration doc for AtlasHealth before next week - @Jordan can you pull the latest? (flagged in slack #solutions-eng)
- Demo environment: request 1 GPU slot for Thursday afternoon to run a 1:1 with RetailPro. @Maya please confirm availability.

Tasks (T-ordered):
- [ ] Send OptiSecure VM follow-up email with two times (by 09:45)
- [ ] Create 1-pager: Private deployment + SOC2 bullets (use template from confluence) (by EOD)
- [ ] Block demo env for RetailPro (confirm with Maya)
- [ ] Add NovaInfra to mau weekly report if discovery goes well (tag: potential-dedicated)

Notes to self / reflections:
- Opening pitch too focused on raw perf; try leading with reliability + cost predictability for infra teams.
- Bring quantized model examples as cost comparators in pricing convos.
- Keep cadence light on email - one short VM + single CTAs seems to work better than long threads.

Quick links (to paste in messages):
- Private deployment overview: https://confluence.redwood/private-deployments/overview
- Dedicated pricing sheet (internal): https://drive.redwood/pricing/dedicated-q1-2026.xlsx
- Demo booking calendar: https://calendar.redwood/demo-ava

End of scratchpad.
